answer: Require every identity to keep a live pulse: each epoch it must sign and post proof of unique work done since its last pulse, a hash chain no two identities can share. Entry costs 150 POA locked 60 days, and a ridge of rising cost blocks repeats: a second identity locks 300 POA and sustains two pulse streams with non-overlapping work, a third 600 POA and three streams, so each fake multiplies capital and labour. In a gale of sign-ups, a missed or copied pulse freezes rewards instantly; auditors verify pulse hashes, locks and funding links, slashing 35% of linked stakes for duplicated work.
